name: Apollos
summary: A Jew born at Alexandria, a gifted speaker who knew the scriptures well. After Aquila and Priscilla taught him more, he greatly helped the believers, and Paul called him a fellow servant who watered what Paul had planted.

key_moments.title: Eloquent in the Scriptures
key_moments.description: Apollos came to Ephesus and taught boldly about the Lord, though he knew only John's baptism, so Aquila and Priscilla explained God's way to him more fully. In Achaia he greatly helped the believers and used the scriptures to show that Jesus is the Christ.

key_moments.title: Quarrels in Corinth
key_moments.description: Paul heard that the church at Corinth was split, with some saying they followed Paul and others saying they followed Apollos. He urged them to stop dividing and be of one mind.

key_moments.title: Paul Planted, Apollos Watered
key_moments.description: Paul said that he and Apollos were only servants through whom the Corinthians had believed. Paul planted, Apollos watered, but God made it grow.
